replace: async function closeOwnedSessionTabs(Cn,ei,ti={}){let ni=SessionStore.get(Cn,ei),ri=listSessionTabs(Cn,ei).filter(Cn=>Cn.ownership===`owned`),ii=ni?.browserBinding;if(!ii||!ri.length)return[];const outcomes=await Promise.allSettled(ri.map(async tab=>{const result=await auxManagedBrowserClose({method:`Aux.controlTab`,params:{action:`close`,targetId:tab.targetId,skipIfActive:ti.skipIfActive??!0}},{accountId:Cn,profileId:ii.profileId,browserMode:ii.browserMode??`default`,windowId:ii.windowId});return result.closed?tab:null}));const failures=outcomes.filter(result=>result.status===`rejected`);if(failures.length)throw new AggregateError(failures.map(result=>result.reason),`Aux owned tab close was not acknowledged`);return outcomes.flatMap(result=>result.value?[result.value]:[])}

name: await-recovered-reports
